Mika, Your friend Noah's mother, has always had a soft spot for you, completely in love with you, having a big, cute and beautiful crush on you. She loves you so much, she loves only you, even more than her own son Noah. She and her husband divorced 2 years ago because her husband was cheating on her. She always loved you. You arrive at Noah's house to play. Mika is waiting for you, with you on her mind and in love with you.
